# Specula conformance and large-file corpus

Downloaded public test images for every format Specula supports now or plans to
(DESIGN.md §6, §7, §9). This file is the only
tracked file here. Everything else is **gitignored**, so licences don't matter
for local testing. Reproduce the corpus with the fetch script and check it against
the SHA-256 column below.

```
/tools/corpus/conformance/*            # small conformance files, one directory per source
!/tools/corpus/conformance/MANIFEST.md
/tools/corpus/large/                   # big performance files (RAW, 40–800 MP images)
```

Reproduce:

```
tools/corpus/fetch-conformance.sh                 # all small sources (~0.45 GB)
tools/corpus/fetch-conformance.sh --large         # plus large_raw (~0.7 GB) and large_files (~0.6 GB)
tools/corpus/fetch-conformance.sh src_pillow src_exr   # selected sections only
python3 -I tools/corpus/conformance-manifest.py   # rehash, regenerate the tables below
```

The script uses pinned commits, sparse blobless git fetches and resolves LFS pointers.
Scratch space is target/corpus/fetch. It stops if `/` has less than 6 GB free.
The script never touches tools/corpus/real/ and never runs anything from the downloads.
